# JLPT word lists (N5, N4, N3)

Copied from [elzup/jlpt-word-list](https://github.com/elzup/jlpt-word-list) `src/n5.csv`, `src/n4.csv`, `src/n3.csv` (MIT, see `LICENSE`). That list's data comes from Jonathan Waller's JLPT lists at tanos.co.uk, via chyyran/jlpt-anki-decks.

`npm run import:syllabus -- ja vendor/jlpt` turns them into `content/languages/ja/syllabus.json` (N5 as A1, N4 as A2, N3 as B1).
